how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points on Regalia F:
HDFC Regalia First Credit Card provides two options to redeem the reward points.
Redeem reward points for gifts and travel bookings.
Redeem reward points for flights and hotel bookings.
how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points for Flights:
Reward points earned on HDFC Regalia First Credit Card can be instantly redeemed for air ticket and hotel bookings on ixigo website. Each reward point can be exchanged for 30 paise. Follow the mentioned steps below to redeem Regalia reward points:
Visit ixigo.com/hdfcbankrewardprogram
Search for a flight or hotel based on a selected date.
Fills in the other details and Select Regalia First Card.
Make your booking with your reward points and pay the remaining fee, if any, with your card.
how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points for Gifts?:
Reward points accrued on your Regalia First Credit Card can also be redeemed for exciting gifts available in HDFC Bank’s reward catalogue. Below are the steps to redeem reward points online using HDFC net banking account:
Sign in to HDFC credit card online account.
Select your credit card and click on Continue.
Go to Online Redemptions -> Redeem Reward Points.
Select points range and item category to find the gifts.
Now select the product and add it to the cart.
Click on Confirm to confirm the redemption.
Upon successful redemption the selected gift will be delivered to your registered mailing address. Make a note of the Redemption Order Number to track the delivery.
Alternatively, you can also redeem your reward points through the post.
